verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a flow builder in which flows consist of a trigger followed by actions, so multi-step workflows are supported. It also claims users can connect 760+ apps "without writing glue code" and positions itself as an open-source Zapier replacement. The evidence never explicitly describes the builder as a visual or drag-and-drop canvas, and no hands-on account confirms that ops users can build flows without code, so coverage is not complete. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the visual editor and its interaction model (canvas, branching, step configuration UI), independent or hands-on confirmation of no-code multi-step building by non-developers.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code

citations.quote: Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions
Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated
Put a flow builder, AI agents and 760+ integrations inside your own product
Move data, send messages and update records between 764 apps without writing glue code.
An open source replacement for Zapier
